records.title: LoRASuite: Efficient LoRA Adaptation Across Large Language Model Upgrades
records.reason: The primary abstract reduces LoRA adaptation memory and compute when transferring between model upgrades; these are adaptation/training costs rather than inference efficiency.

records.title: CAFE: Retrieval Head-based Coarse-to-Fine Information Seeking to Enhance Multi-Document QA Capability
records.reason: The primary abstract proposes retrieval-head filtering and attention steering to improve multi-document question answering; it reports answer-quality gains but no inference/serving efficiency result.

records.title: Beyond Low-rank Decomposition: A Shortcut Approach for Efficient On-Device Learning
records.reason: The primary abstract studies on-device learning and reports activation-memory and training-FLOP savings; its contribution is training efficiency.

records.title: Self-alignment of Large Video Language Models with Refined Regularized Preference Optimization
records.reason: The primary abstract proposes a preference-optimization/self-alignment training method for video-language models and reports alignment quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: LVLM-Compress-Bench: Benchmarking the Broader Impact of Large Vision-Language Model Compression
records.reason: Adjacent benchmark evidence for multimodal compression, not a demonstrated serving optimization; retained as borderline for scope.
